comments.text: Most older games with multiple disks like Final Fantasy 7, 8 and 9 wasnt bad for me. In fact there was only 1 game I found annoying and that was a pc game which Myst sequel Riven. Cause it felt like every time you went to one of the other islands you had to change the disk. Though I think there was only 3 or 4 disks then when you had to go to a previous island like the first island you had to change back to that other disk. You would think a port like the one for the ps5 it would be less annoying since there wasn't any disks. Im sure it was for some people but for me it was more annoying cause the change disk prompt still popped up. And I got tired of seeing the prompt after a while especially since your not actually changing disks
